g.text: A composed trial over the current, retained and metadata domains
each domain runs its own bounded trial; the first refusal keeps all three predecessors
Commit t, Evict v, Pin p or Unpin p
over the semantic graph, current limits
over the semantic graph, retained limits
over the metadata graph, metadata limits
base is the triple of their predecessors
never an input to a trial
replaces the metadata root on Commit and Evict
On ranked graphs the successor equals, domain by domain,
the cold ledger for the successor entries' roots:
with the retained-only objects as the difference.
